hero.badge: In force since 18 October 2024 in Belgium
hero.title: Bring your SME into <accent>NIS2 compliance</accent>, without jargon or overspend.
hero.lead: Audit, remediation, alignment with CyFun (CCB): we don't list your gaps, we fix them.
hero.assure3: A single point of contact, no subcontracting
hero.cardText: Since 18 October 2024: it is no longer a deadline, it is an obligation.
hero.cardFoot: Every month counts. We bring you to the expected level and reduce the risk of a penalty.

clair.title: What the directive changes for you, <accent>without jargon</accent>
clair.lead: NIS2 raises the level of cybersecurity required of thousands of organisations. Three questions to find out where you stand.

cyfun.lead: The CyberFundamentals Framework (CyFun), from the Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB), is the recognised way to demonstrate your NIS2 compliance.

niveaux.title: Basic, Important, Essential: choosing the <accent>right level</accent>
niveaux.lead: Three progressive levels. The right choice depends on your NIS2 category and your exposure. We help you decide.

audit.title: Smidjan runs the CyFun audit with a <accent>proprietary tool, secure by design</accent>
audit.lead: My audit engine, aligned with CyFun (CCB) and NIST CSF 2.0, assesses your compliance quickly and on evidence. Then I fix: remediation and hardening.

trust.readOnlyText: The audit observes, it never modifies your systems.
trust.scopeText: Only the hosts you entrust to me. No unrequested scan.
trust.credsText: Read-only service account, provided by you, never kept or exported.
trust.logText: Every action is logged: a traceable and conclusive audit.
trust.humanText: Fixes are proposed for validation, never applied automatically.
trust.noDataText: Report delivered, then audit materials erased.

honesty.title: An assisted self-assessment, not a certification
honesty.p: My tool facilitates the CyFun self-assessment and prepares your file. It does not replace the official verification, reserved for BELAC-accredited bodies.

financement.title: Compliance costs less than people think: <accent>a large part is subsidised</accent>
financement.lead: The Walloon cybersecurity voucher finances a large part of your audit and your remediation. Here is how to make use of it.

finalCta.title: In 30 minutes, know exactly where you stand.
finalCta.text: 30 min with me, directly: NIS2 category, CyFun level, clear priorities. No commitment, no jargon.
finalCta.reassure2: Single point of contact, no subcontracting
